title: Digital Realty Declares Quarterly Cash Dividends for Common and Preferred Stock
summary: AUSTIN, Texas, Aug. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Digital Realty (NYSE: DLR), the world’s largest cloud- and carrier-neutral data center platform, announced today its board of directors has authorized quarterly cash dividends for common and preferred stock for the third quarter of 2026.
